subject: english
question: Identify the sentence that correctly uses the indefinite article.

options.text: I have never seen an UFO in an English movie.
I have never seen a UFO in a English movie.
I have never seen a UFO in an English movie.
I have never seen an UFO in a English movie.

solution:
The correct answer is "**I have never seen a UFO in an English movie.**"
